look.summary_zh: 暖色 · 中灰近原值 · 中段拉开
look.description_zh: 50% 灰输出 Y′ 125.2/255（变化 -2.3 码值）；25%–75% 灰跨度比 1.207。中灰红减蓝 +9.0 码值。浅/中/深肤色色块分别输出 #FFE0CF、#F09C76、#934228；红/绿/蓝测试块分别输出 #FD171C、#01D92E、#2823C4。
look.description_en: 50% gray Y′ 125.2/255 (-2.3 code values); 25–75% gray span ratio 1.207; mid-gray red minus blue +9.0 code values. Light/medium/deep skin swatches: #FFE0CF, #F09C76, #934228. Red/green/blue swatches: #FD171C, #01D92E, #2823C4.
look.suggested_use_zh: 暖色生活、餐饮与怀旧试片
look.suggested_use_en: Compare on your own SDR product, portrait and landscape footage before selecting.
look.cautions_zh: 逐项比较肤色与品牌色，强度过高可能改变产品颜色。仅像素颜色映射，不生成颗粒、光晕、暗角、空间雾或美颜；未做自然画质验收。
look.cautions_en: Pixel color mapping only; no grain, glow, vignette, spatial haze or beauty effects. Natural footage quality is unaccepted. Check skin/product colors and clipped output.
